title: MIN Stock Alert
flavorText: MIN() finds the lowest value per group. Here you use it to find the most under-stocked product in each category.
narrative: Identify the minimum stock level per category so the Bureau knows where shortages are most critical.
schemaSql: CREATE TABLE products (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL, price REAL NOT NULL, stock INTEGER NOT NULL);
seedSql: INSERT INTO products VALUES (1,'Datapad','Electronics',299.99,45),(2,'Power Cell','Electronics',19.99,200),(3,'Steel Cable','Hardware',8.50,500),(4,'Logic Board','Electronics',89.99,30),(5,'Ceramic Fuse','Hardware',2.25,1000),(6,'Optic Lens','Optics',149.99,15),(7,'Servo Motor','Robotics',55.00,80),(8,'Pressure Valve','Hardware',12.75,300);
task: Find the minimum stock level per category. Order by min_stock ascending.

hints.text: MIN(stock) returns the smallest stock value per GROUP BY category.
SELECT category, MIN(stock) AS min_stock FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY min_stock;
SELECT category, MIN(stock) AS min_stock FROM products GROUP BY category ORDER BY min_stock;
